title: 18th Century Coat Replica
overview: Historically detailed 18th-century coat replica focused on historical garment reconstruction, textile sourcing, precision pattern design, and specialized tailoring.
scope: Historical pattern drafting, material sourcing, structural tailoring, and allocation of funding for specialized textile supplies.
materials:
• Historically appropriate textiles (wool or similar period fabric)
 • Lining fabric
 • Thread, buttons, and period-appropriate trim/hardware
 • Pattern paper for drafting
fabricationSteps:
1. Research the target period's coat construction and silhouette.
 2. Draft a custom pattern based on historical references and the wearer's measurements.
 3. Source period-appropriate textiles and trim.
 4. Cut the fabric pieces according to the pattern.
 5. Construct the coat using period-appropriate tailoring techniques (structured interlining, hand-finished details where applicable).
 6. Fit and adjust the coat, then finish with buttons and trim.
 7. Photograph the completed coat and document with video.
outcome: Successfully constructed a complete 18th-century coat replica with detailed photography and a video presentation.
